title: Launch of the Green and Digital Universities project

blocks.text: On 11 January 2024, the project “Green and Digital Universities for Sustainable Development of Kyrgyzstan” was launched at the K. Dikambaev Diplomatic Academy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic, with financial support from the EU Erasmus+ programme. The project consortium includes 10 universities in Kyrgyzstan, the University of Hamburg in Germany, Vilnius University in Lithuania and the CBC Group.
